purpose: Decide where the custom engine merits further work before any new kernel tuning.
timing: Fresh serial process per seed/trial/batch/engine; rotate order; resident prepared inputs; include input/output finite validation and normal API work; compilation/export/setup and first call separately reported; no clock subtraction.
compiled_contract: Pure tensor graph with fullgraph=True, fixed batch/context, inference mode, no silent eager fallback; validation surrounds the graph within each measured call. Record compile errors and graph breaks.
onnx_contract: CPUExecutionProvider only; graph optimization all, sequential execution, one intra/inter-op thread, spinning disabled; same preprocessing, positions, exact GELU, last-query attention and correction head; export/optimized graphs retained locally and hashed.
admission: Verify each engine against independent reference and all 32 saved windows per model/batch before timing. Wrong output selection, unsupported operators, graph breaks or source identity mismatch block acceptance.
gate: For each batch independently: native_core median of nine cell p50s <= 1.20 times the smallest baseline median p50, AND native_core median of nine cell p99s <= 1.20 times the smallest baseline median p99. Baselines are current eager Torch, compiled Torch and ONNX CPU; all must complete and pass parity. Report wrapper separately.
stopping: Preserve failure/timeout/partial records. Fix a demonstrated correctness or environment defect in a new run; do not retune kernels, change tolerances or silently rerun a poor result. A supported-runtime failure prevents a complete frontier claim.
